source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesGamesMinecraft: DELUXE COLLECTIONReleases 10/27/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - Minecraft: DELUXE COLLECTIONFantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesLoadingCreate, explore and survive alone or with friends CREATE. EXPLORE. SURVIVE. Build anything you can imagine, uncover mysteries, and face thrilling foes in an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. There’s no wrong way to play! Jump in with the DELUXE COLLECTION including: Three add-ons: Celebration Food, Rescue Dogs, and Plenty O’ Blocks; 3 exclusive Character Creator items; and 700 Minecoins*. VIBRANT VISUALS**Vibrant Visuals is Minecraft’s biggest official visual enhancement – delivering a dazzling cosmetic upgrade with a new modern graphics pipeline and an array of visual improvements. Sunrises are more vivid, water reflects, forests become shaded, and more!INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACKExplore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals** enabled! The pack also features 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the iconic Super Mario™ series.CreateBuild anything you can imagine in the ultimate sandbox game. Explore Uncover the mysteries of an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough.SurviveTake on challenging foes, thrilling landscapes and perilous dimensions. PLAY TOGETHER***Have a blast with friends, whether you’re sitting on the same couch in split screen or miles apart in cross-platform play. Connect with millions of players on community servers or join your own private server with up to 10 friends with Realms Plus. EXPERIENCE MORECreator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics are available on the Minecraft Marketplace. Marketplace Pass (or Realms Plus) includes 150+ worlds, skin & textures packs, and more – refreshed monthly. Nintendo Switch™ 2 Features:VIBRANT VISUALS** - Dig into your Minecraft adventure on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system with Vibrant Visuals support and embark on a journey across a world with enhanced lighting and shadow effects. Enjoy Vibrant Visuals enabled content across Minecraft Marketplace.CARRY OVER DATA FROM THE Nintendo Switch™ VERSION - Nintendo Switch™ worlds can be carried over, so you can pick up right where you left off.INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACK - Explore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled!*Included Minecoins and any Minecoins purchased in Minecraft on a Nintendo device must be used in the Nintendo ecosystem. **Vibrant Visuals not available in some gameplay, including split-screen and when using certain Marketplace Worlds and content. ***Cross-platform play requires Microsoft Account. Online multiplayer functionality requires a Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately).Software description provided by the publisher.Bundle includes the following:For details on the products in this bundle, including up-to-date system compatibility information, please refer to each product page listed below.MinecraftGamesMINECRAFT: DELUXE COLLECTION DLCGamesPublisher notification(s):Already own a digital version of Minecraft for Nintendo Switch™? Get a digital Minecraft Standard Edition for Nintendo Switch™ 2 for free or pre-order the Deluxe Collection or Ultimate Collection at a discount by January 31, 2027.About this itemSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1-4)Local wireless (2-8)Online (2-8)Nintendo Switch OnlineOnline PlaySave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. source.evidenceText: {"steam_appid":5214490,"name":"Colors Of V","type":"game","release_date":{"coming_soon":true,"date":"Oct 14, 2026"},"platforms":{"windows":true,"mac":false,"linux":true},"genres":[{"id":"1","description":"Action"},{"id":"23","description":"Indie"}],"developers":["Ioannis Tzanellis"],"publishers":["7 Towers Soft Games"],"short_description":"A vector dungeon on a monochrome tube, lit by three subtractive colour gels. Drop a gel and half the room stops existing: a wall you cannot see is not solid, an enemy you cannot see is frozen and cannot be shot. The colour channel is the collision layer, so sight and physics never drift."}
